text:
jess: Anyone free to weigh in on adding a protocol toggle in the console? Idea is a per-route switch (rest | grpc | dual) + canary slider. Thinking about rollout UX and what we surface about telemetry/quota impacts.

omar: Per-route toggles sound flexible but scary. Can we start with tenant-level toggles + explicit per-route opt-in? Fewer combinations to reason about.

liam: From the runtime side per-route is doable if we keep decision in the router. Main concerns: transcoding costs and KV cache invalidation when path mapping changes.

sasha: Agreed. Telemetry gets hairy when gateway transcodes: you end up with two different spans for a single user request unless we stitch them. Also sampling biases if transcode is rare.

kate: Ops will want to see the "effective protocol" in traces + a breakdown in the console (pct grpc vs rest over time). Can we add an annotated trace view showing where transcode happened?

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: protocol-toggle canary for `generator-service` -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-05T10:00Z.

omar: We also need a clear contract for what we allow to be transcoded: no bidi streaming, no complex Any/polymorphic fields, and method name mapping must be 1:1. Otherwise behavior diverges.

jess: Proposal: canonical proto is source-of-truth. Gateway may transcode only for routes marked `transcode_allowed`. Disallow streaming on transcode routes. Enforce header `x-redwood-proto: v1` when client intentionally picks proto mode.

liam: Implementation note: add per-route config `transformer: none|transcode|adapter` and `canary_percent`. Router will attach `protocol.choice` tag to spans. Batching rules will differ for transcode paths.

sasha: Telemetry specifics: tag spans with `protocol.choice` (rest|grpc|transcode). Count bytes/tokens on both ingress and egress. For sampling, prefer keeping more transcode traces for the first 7 days so we can inspect behavior.

kate: Quota question: after transcode, which quota is charged? We should count against the backend method (post-transcode) but map it to the original route's quota for visibility. That preserves consumer expectations.

jess: UX idea: console toggle UI with a canary slider (0-100%), an estimated latency/cost delta preview, and an automatic compatibility check reporting dropped or remapped fields. Show a yellow warning if any field will be lost.

omar: Browser SDK edge case: grpc-web support is limited. Default to rest for browser-origin routes and surface a recommended polyfill if teams opt into grpc.

liam: We'll add `client_compat: browser|server` heuristics and auto-fallback to rest in browser flows.

sasha: Action items I care about: (1) header contract (x-redwood-proto, x-redwood-proto-transform), (2) telemetry schema fields and dashboards, (3) quota-mapping rules doc.

jess: I'll draft an RFC tonight with examples and the console mockup. Quick thumbs: prototype this sprint? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

kate: +1 👍

omar: 👍

liam: 👍

sasha: 👍 let's also schedule a 20m demo with infra after the prototype.

deploy-bot: Canary job created at 2026-03-05T09:55Z for route `generator-service` (10% -> grpc). Logs will appear in #eng-platform-canaries.
